reasoning: The 8 previous World Cup winners (Brazil, Germany, Italy, Argentina, France, Uruguay, England, Spain) have dominated historically due to strong football infrastructure and talent pools. Looking at likely 2026 contenders: France, Brazil, Argentina, Germany, England, and Spain remain favorites. Potential first-time winners like Portugal, Netherlands, or Belgium have talent but historically underperform. Host advantage for USA/Mexico/Canada is minimal for winning. The concentration of wins among established powers reflects structural advantages that persist. I estimate roughly 10-15% chance for a first-time winner.
